value: Study subjects were health care students (medical, nursing, dentistry) from Swedish universities (Umeå, Stockholm, Gothenburg)
35 students total: 17 traveled to Central Africa, 18 to Indian peninsula
None of subjects took antibiotics within 6 months prior to sampling
69% of subjects had travelers' diarrhea during trip (median 4 days)
Culture screening for ESBL-producing Enterobacteriaceae performed
Sequencing libraries generated: 57.7-463.8 million read pairs
178 different resistance gene types detected across all specimens
12/18 students from India acquired ESBL-producing E. coli; 0/17 from Africa acquired ESBL-producing strains
